_comment: Shared test vectors for text normalization. The TypeScript implementation (packages/core/src/text.ts) and the Python one (benchmarks/asr/normalization.py) both run these. Index-time and query-time normalization diverging is a silent retrieval failure, and two implementations of it is exactly how that happens — AI_PIPELINE.md §8.
